item.title: Congress approves 10-day extension for warrantless surveillance law
item.summary: Trump officials say the program is vital to national security, but skeptics — including some Republicans — have stonewalled its reauthorization without changes to protect civil liberties.

item.title: Trump says Iran agrees to hand over ‘nuclear dust’
item.summary: Iran has not confirmed Trump’s claim. Giving up its highly enriched uranium would be a major step toward an agreement.

item.title: House narrowly rejects resolution directing Trump to end ‘hostilities’ in Iran
item.summary: The Senate turned back a similar measure Wednesday seeking to rein in the president as the unpopular war approaches the two-month mark.

item.title: How every House member voted on blocking Trump from striking Iran
item.summary: The House is voting on a measure to block President Trump from ordering more strikes on Iran. See how your lawmaker voted.

item.title: Trump says Iran has agreed to nearly all his demands
item.summary: Officials in Tehran said the Strait of Hormuz would reopen to commercial shipping, but they dismissed the president’s claims of a wider agreement with the U.S.

item.title: Trump administration deepens quest to stamp out the events of Jan. 6
item.summary: In his second term, the president has doubled down on efforts to reframe public perception of the 2021 attack on the U.S. Capitol, in court and beyond.

item.title: 10-day ceasefire in Lebanon begins as Israel agrees to U.S.-backed deal
item.summary: President Donald Trump announced the agreement, which went into force Thursday evening, as Pakistani mediators worked to extend a U.S.-Iran ceasefire and arrange new talks.

item.title: Trump officially taps Erica Schwartz to lead CDC, avoiding vaccine skeptics
item.summary: A new team could mark a shift away from Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s unpopular vaccine agenda ahead of the midterms.

item.title: Federal judge sets new limits on Trump ballroom construction
item.summary: U.S. District Judge Richard Leon clarified that some national security work can continue while the overall project is halted. Trump attacked him on social media.

item.title: Supreme Court hands win to Chevron, Big Oil in environmental damage case
item.summary: The decision puts into question a $745 million judgment against Chevron to help restore coastal wetlands in Louisiana that were damaged as long ago as World War II.
